output.recommended_action:
1. Acknowledge the ticket and confirm receipt with the customer within 2 business hours (per fallback SLA). 
2. Access the internal Order Management System (OMS) to retrieve the full fulfillment record for order #ORD-8819, including carrier name, tracking number, shipment date, and current status. 
3. Verify that the shipping address on file matches the address the customer expects. 
4. If the OMS shows the order is still pending or on hold, immediately request the Fulfillment Team to release and ship the parts using an expedited, tracked carrier. 
5. If the order has been shipped, locate the tracking number and check the carrier’s tracking portal for the latest status. 
   a. If tracking shows a delay or “in transit” beyond normal transit time, open a carrier investigation (e.g., UPS/FEDEX claim) and request an expedited re‑ship. 
   b. If tracking shows “delivered,” verify delivery location; if the customer still reports non‑receipt, still open a carrier investigation per policy before any further escalation. 
6. Document all findings and actions in the ticket per TSG-204 troubleshooting guide. 
7. Provide the customer with a status update within the next 24 hours, including any tracking information, investigation reference numbers, and expected resolution timeline (aiming to resolve within 5 business days). 
8. If the carrier investigation confirms loss or irrecoverable delay, arrange a replacement shipment at no cost to the customer and note a goodwill credit in the account notes (do not issue the credit directly).

output.response_text:
Dear Enterprise Client 21,

Thank you for bringing the delay with replacement parts order #ORD‑8819 to our attention. We understand how critical timely delivery is for your operations, and we apologize for any inconvenience this has caused.

We have begun an immediate investigation and are taking the following actions:

- Verify that the shipping address we have on file matches your expected delivery location.
- Review the order’s fulfillment record in our system to confirm shipment status and obtain the carrier’s tracking details.
- If the order has not yet shipped, we will request an expedited, tracked shipment from our Fulfillment Team.
- If the order has already shipped, we will check the carrier’s tracking portal. Should the tracking indicate a delay or an unexpected delivery status, we will open a carrier investigation and arrange a priority re‑ship at no cost to you.
- Document all findings and keep you updated with any tracking numbers, investigation reference numbers, and an estimated resolution timeline (aiming to resolve within five business days).

We will provide you with a status update within the next 24 hours.

Thank you for your patience and partnership.

Sincerely,
Customer Support Team
